concept: A field that narrows a long list as the reader types, for choosing one value that must come from the list.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a native datalist or a plain text input with a dropdown of all options (jQuery autocomplete) as the combobox
default_to_avoid.why_not: a datalist ignores the system’s look and keyboard, and an unfiltered dropdown of hundreds is a scroll hunt

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the field is Input’s groove; the list opens under it as Select’s sheet, one family

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: focus stays in the field while arrow keys move the highlight and Enter chooses

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: matches are filtered by the typed text; an empty result says so in words

options: A groove with a filtering sheet
C select plus a search box inside the menu
variants.picked: A groove with a filtering sheet
variants.reason: A keeps typing and choosing in one field (WAI-ARIA combobox). B cannot be styled or reached the same way. C moves focus into the popup and loses the field.

root.why: the label above the field, the same gap as every field

label.why: the field’s label in the label size, its accessible name

field.why: a groove like Input with the field’s 3:1 edge, wrapping when it holds chips

input.why: the typing space, a 44px target that never shrinks below a short word

chevron.why: a chevron in secondary text that says a list opens from here

focus-within.why: the field shows the focus ring while its input has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the field, the same in every theme and on every scene

disabled.why: an off control dims and refuses presses, so it reads as there but not available

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words
